title: Binance Wallet Introduces New Wallet Extension With Keyless Security Access
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet is excited to introduce the launch of Binance Wallet Extension (Beta)! Users can now securely manage crypto assets, interact with dApps, and explore Web3 - all directly from their desktop web browser. The extension offers a simple, secure, and seamless way to explore Web3 without compromising control. Whether users are new to crypto or already using Binance Wallet, the extension provides an intuitive way to explore the decentralized world directly from the browser. Key Features Effortless Setup :  Forget the risk of lost recovery phrases. Instantly log in using the Binance App and unlock Binance Keyless Wallet with a simple QR scan — no complex setup required. Alternatively, users can  import existing wallets  using a seed phrase or private key and manage them all in one place. Enhanced Security:   Binance Wallet Extension uses the advanced  Keyless (MPC)  technology to generate three separately stored key shares, eliminating a single point of failure.  Users can also receive proactive alerts about risky tokens, contracts, or blockchains, which help them stay safe while navigating the Web3 space. Seamless dApp Connections:  Connect to dApps and explore DeFi, trading, staking, and more, all directly in one browser. Multi-Chain Support:  Manage assets across EVM, Solana, and TRON networks.  Fully Synced Experience : Access the same wallet across mobile and browser effortlessly. How to Get Started Install the Binance Wallet Extension from the  Chrome Web Store . Open the extension and click  [Set Up Wallet] . You have two options: Log in to Binance Keyless Wallet : Scan the QR code using your Binance App and confirm the pairing code on both devices. Import your existing wallet : Choose  [Import Seed Phrase Wallet]  or [ Import Private Key Wallet] , then enter your seed phrase or private key. Set a password for the extension (required for first-time users). Start exploring Web3 seamlessly from your web browser! Notes: This is a beta release, which is an early version of the wallet extension with limited features. More capabilities will be added in the future. Currently, Binance Wallet Extension (Beta) is supported on Google Chrome only. Support for additional browsers will be rolled out in the future. For enhanced security, sessions automatically expire after 24 hours of inactivity, with a maximum login duration of 48 hours (subject to change). For users logging in via Binance Keyless Wallet, please ensure their Binance App is on version  2.102.2 or above .
